# OINK Landing Example
> A complete example of OINK's composable landing page.
## Site index
- [Home page](https://example.org/)
- [Documentation](https://example.org/docs/)
- [Blog](https://example.org/blog/)
## Documentation index
- [Nested guides](https://example.org/docs/guides/): A section fixture that proves tree-order navigation across levels.
- [First nested guide](https://example.org/docs/guides/first/index.md): The first leaf below a section index.
- [Pager opt-out](https://example.org/docs/guides/opt-out/index.md): A page-level fixture for disabling sequential navigation.
- [Callouts](https://example.org/docs/components/callouts/index.md): GitHub / Obsidian style callouts rendered by the blockquote render hook.
- [Typography fixture](https://example.org/docs/typography/): Representative prose, labels, and code for theme regression checks.
- [Enhanced code blocks](https://example.org/docs/code-blocks/index.md): Regression fixtures for the shared Chroma shell and code groups.
- [Steps](https://example.org/docs/components/steps/index.md): Ordered-list steps (native form) and heading steps (full form).
- [Math passthrough](https://example.org/docs/math-passthrough/index.md): Regression fixtures for delimiter-style server-rendered mathematics.
- [Cards / FileTree / Gallery](https://example.org/docs/components/lists/index.md): List-based native forms selected by a trailing marker.
- [Content primitives](https://example.org/docs/content-primitives/index.md): Regression fixtures for inline everyday content primitives.
- [Media primitives](https://example.org/docs/media-primitives/index.md): Regression fixtures for shared image resolution and the processed image shortcode.
- [Image Zoom](https://example.org/docs/image-zoom/index.md): Regression fixtures for opt-in native image preview.
- [Image Zoom disabled](https://example.org/docs/image-zoom-disabled/): A page-level false value wins over the enabled example site.
- [Image Zoom exclusions](https://example.org/docs/image-zoom-exclusions/): A page with only ineligible images must not load the runtime.
- [Cards (rich)](https://example.org/docs/components/cards/index.md): The `{{</* cards */>}}` / `{{</* card */>}}` full form with icons, badges, images and Markdown bodies.
- [Tables](https://example.org/docs/components/tables/index.md): Table family — fields, matrix, caption, numbered, tabs, full-width.
- [Data fences](https://example.org/docs/components/data-fences/index.md): Declarative charts, infographics and checksum lists as fenced code blocks.
- [Download data demo](https://example.org/docs/download-demo/index.md): Rolling and pinned channels render from one validated data record.
- [Gallery](https://example.org/docs/gallery/index.md): Regression fixtures for a static-first responsive image Gallery.
- [Gallery with Zoom disabled](https://example.org/docs/gallery-disabled/): Gallery remains complete when page-level Image Zoom is disabled.
- [Release assets with an explicit base](https://example.org/docs/release-assets-base/index.md): Asset tables can remain useful outside release pages without inventing version facts.
- [Unpublished download demo](https://example.org/docs/download-pending/index.md): Pinned release facts remain visible without exposing download actions.
## Site locales
- [English](https://example.org/)
